verdict: Ascended Heroes is holding value better: AH26 88.45 vs CR26 85.28 on the Sep 28 mark (since the Aug 24 launch at 100.00: −11.55% vs −14.72%), ahead at all five weekly marks (gap 4.96, 4.26, 2.00, 0.71, 3.17). Latest week −5.8% (AH) vs −8.5% (CR, its biggest weekly fall). Top three sold-comp medians sum $2,136.00 vs $346.50. Chaos Rising is the far cheaper sealed entry: ETB lowest ask $62.00 (26 live) vs $140.00 (17 live), booster bundle $33.99 vs $74.99, CR factory booster box $205.00 (2 live), no AH factory box listing (Sep 30).
